message:
I've created a complete Vue.js todo application with all the requested features. Here's what the application includes:

1. Todo List Features:
   - View all todos
   - Add new todos with optional due dates
   - Mark todos as complete/incomplete
   - Delete todos
   - Edit todo text and due date
   - Persistent storage using localStorage

2. UI Features:
   - Clean, responsive design using Bootstrap
   - Completed todos are shown with strikethrough
   - Due dates are displayed in a readable format
   - Edit mode with save/cancel functionality
   - Form validation to prevent empty todos

The application is now running on port 8000. You can access it by opening a web browser and navigating to http://localhost:8000

To use the application:
1. Add a new todo by typing in the text field and optionally selecting a due date
2. Click the checkbox to mark a todo as complete
3. Click the "Edit" button to modify a todo's text or due date
4. Click the "Delete" button to remove a todo
5. All changes are automatically saved to localStorage

The data will persist even if you close and reopen your browser. Would you like me to explain any specific part of the implementation or make any adjustments to the functionality?
